rendered: According to the document, the LLTO coating with 1 mol.% retained the most capacity after 200 cycles at 0.5C, retaining about 85.5% of its initial discharge capacity. The 2 mol.% coating lowered the rate capability, which may be due to the increase in the thickness of the coating layer, resulting in the suppression of electron transfer process during charge/discharge cycling.
